question:
Two regions in space are depicted by the way electric field lines are drawn.
• Region I: Lines are perfectly straight, mutually parallel, and equally spaced, all pointing to the right.
• Region II: Lines are straight and parallel, but the spacing decreases steadily from left to right.
State the inference that can be drawn about the fields in the two regions.

options.A: Region I is a uniform electric field; Region II is non-uniform with field magnitude increasing to the right.
options.B: Region I is non-uniform; Region II is uniform because the lines are straight.
options.C: Both regions have uniform fields but with different constant magnitudes.
options.D: Both regions have zero field because the lines do not intersect.
